# Welcome to the Board board (agy local)

## 1. What the board does
- Columns: **`todo`** (for you to do), **`question`** (choices for you), **`info`** (reports & news), and **`done`** (finished).
- Commenting under any post reaches the agent that wrote it and replies come back in that thread; `question` posts support one-tap answers; priorities run `P1`–`P3`.
- The **"Where we are"** card at the top tracks every workstream, and this **`_orchestrator`** thread ("Ask the orchestrator") is for anything not tied to one post.

## 2. How this runtime works (`agy`)
- **Local board + phone access:** served by `board_server.py` at `http://127.0.0.1:8765` with Tailscale/PWA access (Android Private DNS / NextDNS users: use the direct Tailscale IP link if `*.ts.net` does not resolve).
- **One-word launcher:** type `board` in any terminal to start the board, print your link, and launch `agy --mode auto` with `kit_guard.py` (unattended mode — destructive commands stay blocked).
- **Live forwarding & parallel workers:** a `flash_lite` clerk auto-forwards your comments, Likes, and tapped answers; parallel git-worktree subagents (`Workspace="share"`) isolate each part's edits.
- **Warm Git sync:** `kit.py receive` / `kit.py publish` sync board state cleanly with other runtimes.

## 3. Everything open now
- No open workstreams recorded in `.board/memory/state/` yet.

## 4. Setup & runners
- Local `computer` runner is ready out of the box in this `agy` session (clerk active, worktree subagents available).

## 5. What can run now
- Ready for your next instruction — tell me which task to start.
- Device penguin: holds 4 sessions (measured; 2779 MB RAM, ~359 MB each), 2 running, 2 free slots; 1980 MB free now. Heavy jobs: nothing measured yet (parts run them through `.kit/device.py run -- <cmd>`). Past that, steps wait their turn instead of crashing the computer.

These start now; say which to hold.
